coordinateSystem.note: This is the mathematical inverse of the typographic Y convention in CMSN-GEOMETRY-SPEC.json (baseline=Y0, capline=Y1000). Documented inversion for SVG authoring, not a design change. Established in Phase 3A/3B, unchanged here.
coordinateSystem.coordinatePrecisionPolicy: 2 decimal places on all path/viewBox coordinates (0.01 unit = 0.001% of cap height, far below any established tolerance). This precision was already used throughout Phase 3B construction and is preserved exactly, not re-rounded.

boundingBox.note: Stroke-inclusive visual ink bounding box equals the viewBox exactly - verified analytically: every path terminus is a butt cap positioned exactly at a viewBox edge, and every stroke's perpendicular half-width (87.155u) is already absorbed into the centerline inset used during Phase 3B construction.

cornerCurveTreatment.status: AUTHORIZED AND PERMANENT - DO NOT REVERT TO STRAIGHT-LINE CONSTRUCTION
cornerCurveTreatment.description: Each stem/diagonal junction is a cubic Bezier fit by least-squares directly to the raster's measured edge boundary, anchored at the stem-top point and the independently-established straight-diagonal line.
cornerCurveTreatment.vertexNote: Directly evidenced as the intersection of two independently-fit straight diagonal lines - not the earlier midpoint-of-transition-rows derivation.

bottomTerminalCorrection.status: APPROVED AND PERMANENT - DO NOT REVERT

boundingBox.note: Both stems are butt-capped vertical segments touching the viewBox top/bottom edges exactly.

diagonalRetention.status: RETAINED AS-IS - DO NOT MODIFY FOR CONVENTIONALITY
diagonalRetention.note: Corner-to-corner centerline construction between stem centerlines. Row-by-row check (7 rows) showed RMS ~1.5px (1.4% cap height) with zero-crossing residuals - a good fit, despite a 1.25-degree gap against a separately-measured edge-fit angle metric. Root-caused to measurement methodology, not a construction defect. Do not change merely because a different construction might appear more geometrically conventional (Phase 3C instruction 4).

N.constructionNote: Validated Phase 3B reconstruction. Retained without modification through the Phase 3B correction pass and Phase 3C.

assemblyContract.description: The wordmark is deterministic from 4 immutable glyph masters + 3 explicit gap values. A future developer can reconstruct it without visual judgment: place C at x=0; place M at x = C.width + gapCM; place S at x = M.x + M.width + gapMS; place N at x = S.x + S.width + gapSN. Total width = N.x + N.width. No kerning, no per-pair visual adjustment, no glyph modification for spacing.

CM.supersedes: 330.28u/36px (original Phase 3A convention mismatch, see CMSN-PHASE3B-CORRECTION-LOG.md item 1)

spacing.note: Spacing is an assembly property only. Do not modify glyph geometry to create optical spacing effects.

mCornerCurvePreservationRule.text: CMSN-MASTER-GLYPH-M.svg's cubic Bezier corner-curve junctions (vertex at 92.80,83.64; left curve control points 11.80,7.0 and 26.20,20.5; right curve control points 175.60,7.0 and 163.20,17.0, all in local glyph units) are a permanent, evidence-derived feature of the CMSN identity. Any tool, process, or person that regenerates, optimizes, simplifies, or re-exports this file MUST preserve these exact path coordinates. A geometry fingerprint mismatch against 295532f1b9f348bc5f353bbfc24f9db559354f9a428b558346aa798ba40498cf indicates an unauthorized alteration.

prohibitedTransformations: Altering Bezier control points, path nodes, or endpoints
Altering stroke widths or stem widths
Altering glyph proportions, cap height, or bounding boxes
Path simplification or coordinate rounding beyond the established 2-decimal precision
Curve-construction conversion (e.g., cubic to quadratic or arc)
SVG optimization tools that rewrite geometry (e.g., SVGO with path-merging or curve-simplification plugins enabled)
Automatic image tracing of any kind
AI-generated approximation or regeneration of the letterforms
Re-kerning or optical spacing adjustment beyond the approved 3 gap values
Merging the slash master into the wordmark without a separately-approved lockup construction

allowedTransformations: Format conversion (SVG to PNG/PDF/EPS etc.) without geometry rewriting
Color substitution limited to the approved color system (black, white; transparent background)

colorSystem.transparentBackgroundBehavior: Master SVGs use stroke="currentColor" with fill="none", enabling colorway-agnostic rendering. Background is transparent by default (no background rect). One geometry, two colorways (black fill / white fill), per existing brand architecture.

svgRequirements: Preserve path d data exactly (verify via geometry fingerprint before any redistribution)
stroke-width, stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin must match the master exactly
rasterExportRequirements: Export at minimum the tested legibility floor - see minimumSize below
Use vector-to-raster export that samples the exact master path data, not an intermediate re-traced version
Maintain aspect ratio (7.5505:1 for the horizontal wordmark)
productionExportRules.apparelVendorHandling: Vendors must receive the master SVG (or a format converted from it without geometry rewriting, e.g. PDF/EPS export preserving path data) plus this specification. Vendors must not be permitted to 'clean up' or 'vectorize' the mark themselves. Any vendor-side digitization (e.g., for embroidery) is a separate, explicitly-scoped derivative process outside this phase and must be validated against the geometry fingerprint before approval.

minimumSize.status: TESTED - DIGITAL RECOMMENDATION ESTABLISHED; PRINT IS AN EXTRAPOLATION PENDING PHYSICAL PROOF
minimumSize.testMethod: Wordmark master rasterized at exact target pixel widths via canvas, then magnified 8x with nearest-neighbor (no smoothing) for direct pixel inspection. No special small-size logo was created; the master geometry was rendered as-is at each size.

observations.result: Letterforms remain nominally distinguishable but are at/below a safe legibility floor - S's internal crossing and M's corner-curve are not reliably discernible.
All four letters clearly distinguishable; fine details (M corner curve) are not perceptible at this size but do not harm legibility.
Very good legibility; counters and S crossing read clearly.

digitalRecommendedMinimum.rationale: Smallest tested size at which all counters and the S crossing read clearly without strain

digitalAbsoluteFloor.rationale: Below this, stroke width approaches 1px and fine structure is not reliably reproduced; not recommended for production use

printMinimum.status: ESTIMATED BY DPI EXTRAPOLATION - NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED BY PHYSICAL PRINT PROOF

at300dpi.rationale: 90px digital recommendation / 300dpi = 0.30in; a direct unit conversion of the digital test, not a separately-run print test

printMinimum.recommendation: Physical print proofing (multiple substrates/print methods) should be run before this print figure is treated as validated.

customTypeSystemFoundation.status: FOUNDATION DOCUMENTED ONLY - NO ADDITIONAL LETTERS DESIGNED
customTypeSystemFoundation.capHeightSystem: 1000-unit normalized cap height, SVG-native y-down coordinate convention, baseline at y=1000
customTypeSystemFoundation.structuralStrokeLogic: Single monoline stroke weight (174.31u = 17.43% of cap height) used identically across every structural element of every glyph - stems, diagonals, terminals, curves. No weight variation within or between letters.
customTypeSystemFoundation.terminalLogic: Flat (butt-capped) terminals throughout; no rounded caps used anywhere in the four validated glyphs.
customTypeSystemFoundation.cornerLogic: Two corner treatments exist in the validated system: (1) C's two large-radius outer corners (circle-fit derived, see CMSN-GEOMETRY-SPEC.md Section D), and (2) M's evidence-derived cubic-Bezier corner-curve junctions. Both are raster-evidence-derived, not stylistic conventions - a future typeface must derive any new letter's corners the same way (from evidence, or from explicit new design decisions), not by copying these specific curves onto unrelated shapes.
customTypeSystemFoundation.curveBehavior: All curves in the validated system (C's corners, M's corner-curves, S's bowl transitions and spine) are cubic or quadratic Beziers fit to or anchored on raster evidence where available; none are stylistic embellishment.
customTypeSystemFoundation.diagonalLogic: M's diagonals run at ~46.2-46.8 degrees from vertical; N's diagonal runs at ~52.9 degrees from vertical (see CMSN-PHASE3B-CORRECTION-LOG.md item 3 for why N's angle was retained despite differing from an edge-fit measurement). These angles are specific to C/M/S/N as measured and are not a generalized 'CMSN diagonal angle' rule to be applied to hypothetical new letters without their own evidence.
customTypeSystemFoundation.spacingPhilosophy: Non-uniform, evidenced spacing (wider C-M gap than M-S/S-N) rather than uniform advance widths - the existing gaps are specific to these four letters' shapes and adjacencies, not a general kerning table.
featuresUniqueToCMSN: The M corner-curve junction (evidence-derived, not a common typographic convention)
The specific non-uniform C-M/M-S/S-N spacing rhythm
The single shared 17.43%-of-cap-height stroke weight across every glyph
customTypeSystemFoundation.logoVsFutureTypefaceDistinction: CMSN-MASTER-GLYPH-{C,M,S,N}.svg and CMSN-MASTER-WORDMARK-HORIZONTAL.svg are LOGO geometry - frozen, immutable, governed by this spec. A future CMSN display typeface would need its OWN full character set (numerals, remaining letters, punctuation) designed to extend this system's logic (stroke weight, terminal/corner philosophy, spacing philosophy) - it must not be used as a pretext to retroactively 'normalize', 'clean up', or redraw C, M, S, or N. Any typeface work is out of scope for Phase 3C and requires separate authorization.

validationTolerances.note: Restated from CMSN-GEOMETRY-SPEC.json for convenience; Level 2/3 master geometry itself is held to zero-drift (geometry fingerprint match), not merely these percentage tolerances, which apply to reconstruction-from-raster fidelity.
